english.title: Bind over - commit breach of the peace
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) behaved in a manner whereby a breach of the peace had been committed and application will be made for an order that you enter into a recognisance with or without sureties to keep the peace
english.pointstoprove:
behaved in a manner
whereby
a breach of the peace
was committed

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This is the wording of the complaint used after police action, such as an arrest in order to prevent anti-social breaches of the peace.
(ii) This is NOT a fingerprintable complaint.
(iii) See H4635 where breach of the peace "was reasonably apprehended".
(iv) See H4537 for 'bind overs' following a complaint, where the order prevents bad behaviour against a specific victim or complainant.
(v) Also see offence wordings: H4636.
